# WeChat to Markdown

> 望山开发的本地优先 Chrome 扩展，主要用于微信公众号阅读、保存与 Markdown 导出。官方网站：https://wx2md.com/。中文为默认语言，英文提供对应页面。

文章正文在浏览器本地处理，不上传给运营者。授权验证、版本检查和可选产品统计有独立的数据边界，详见隐私政策。公开 Community 仓库提供单篇导出；商店完整版另含合集归档和付费功能。不绕过登录、付费墙或访问限制。

价格、免费额度与活动截止时间以购买页及订单服务为准；当前 ZIP 版本与校验值以下载页和 release.json 为准。以下链接说明来自页面元数据，不独立维护价格与版本。

## 中文页面

- [wx2md 官方网站｜WeChat to Markdown 公众号文章归档 Chrome 扩展](https://wx2md.com/): wx2md（WeChat to Markdown）是望山开发和维护的 Chrome 扩展，用于保存微信公众号与文章型网页，免费单篇导出每月 10 次，早鸟永久版不限次数。文章在浏览器本地处理。
- [常见问题：隐私、免费额度与导出方式｜WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/faq/): 了解 WeChat to Markdown 的本地处理、导出格式、免费额度、合集归档、Obsidian 导入、安装与备份边界。
- [wx2md 是什么？官网、源码与隐私说明｜WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/about/): wx2md（WeChat to Markdown）是望山开发和维护的 Chrome 扩展。查看官方网站、官方 GitHub 仓库、功能边界、版本渠道与文章本地处理说明。
- [开始使用 WeChat to Markdown｜三步保存第一篇公众号文章](https://wx2md.com/start/): WeChat to Markdown 安装后的首次使用指引：固定扩展、打开公众号文章、完成第一次免费 Markdown 导出。
- [服务与版权说明｜WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/terms/): 软件服务、第三方内容使用边界、交付异常、退款及权利投诉说明。
- [隐私政策｜WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/privacy/): WeChat to Markdown 隐私政策：了解文章本地处理、扩展授权、免费额度与产品使用统计、网站访问统计、数据保存和用户权利。
- [安装、导出与授权支持｜WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/support/): WeChat to Markdown 使用支持：排查安装、文章导出、合集归档和卡密激活问题，加入微信交流群或提交产品反馈。
- [下载 WeChat to Markdown｜Chrome 商店与官网 ZIP 版](https://wx2md.com/download/): 从 Chrome Web Store 在线安装 WeChat to Markdown，或直接下载国内可访问的官网 ZIP 版。对比自动更新与手动更新的区别。

- [WeChat to Markdown 官网 ZIP 安装与更新教程](https://wx2md.com/offline-install/): 在 Chrome 或 Edge 中安装 WeChat to Markdown 官网 ZIP 版，并在新版本发布后安全覆盖更新。
- [微信公众号合集怎么下载？分卷、断点与增量归档｜wx2md](https://wx2md.com/wechat-collection/): 用 WeChat to Markdown 归档公开微信公众号合集：免费试导出 5 篇，永久版支持每 20 篇分卷、断点继续、完整重导与增量归档。
- [微信公众号文章怎么转 Markdown？完整保存正文、图片与来源｜wx2md](https://wx2md.com/wechat-to-markdown/): 用 WeChat to Markdown 将微信公众号文章导出为带来源信息的 Markdown，可选下载正文图片，并继续整理到 Obsidian、思源或本地知识库。

## English pages

Local-first WeChat article archiving. Article bodies stay in the browser. The public Community repository and full store version have different feature scopes. See pricing and privacy pages for current terms.

- [Save WeChat Articles as Markdown, Locally | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/): A local-first Chrome extension for saving WeChat Official Account articles as Markdown, with optional local images for Obsidian and other note-taking tools.
- [Frequently asked questions | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/faq/): Understand privacy, free allowances, export formats, collection archiving, installation and local backups.
- [About WeChat to Markdown | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/about/): A local-first Chrome extension for reading, saving and exporting WeChat Official Account articles. Built and maintained by Wangshan; the official website is wx2md.com.
- [Installed. Save your first article. | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/start/): No account or purchase is required to begin. Open a WeChat article you can access, then follow these three steps.
- [Terms and copyright | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/terms/): WeChat to Markdown is a local-first format conversion and organization tool. A software purchase does not license third-party articles, images or other materials.
- [Privacy policy | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/privacy/): Articles and public collection content are processed in your browser. The operator does not receive, sell or analyze that content.
- [Help us reproduce the problem | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/support/): Refresh the page, confirm your version and record the complete error. Clear steps make it easier to diagnose a failed export.
- [Choose how to install | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/download/): Use the Chrome Web Store when available, or download the official ZIP directly from this website. Features, prices and license entitlements are the same.
- [Early-bird lifetime · CNY 29 | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/purchase/): Unlimited exports and full archiving. Pay once before October 1, 2026 at 23:59 Beijing time and keep purchased entitlements for life.
- [Install and update the official ZIP | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/offline-install/): Keep the unpacked folder in one permanent location. ZIP installation changes how you install and update, not whether image downloads, licensing or version checks use the network.
- [Archive collections in recoverable parts | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/wechat-collection/): Save up to 20 articles per volume. Progress advances after a successful save, so you can resume interruptions and archive only new articles next time.
- [Turn WeChat articles into useful Markdown | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/wechat-to-markdown/): Preserve titles, authors, publication dates, source links and article structure. Add local images when you need an offline archive.
- [Bring WeChat articles into your Obsidian vault | WeChat to Markdown](https://wx2md.com/en/wechat-to-obsidian/): Keep the body in Markdown, images at relative paths and source information in Front Matter. Your files remain portable when you change computers or tools.
